description: Saves today's daily check-in to the user's own Recalibrate account (requires a connected account): how they feel overall (1 to 10), whether it is a flare day and how bad, triggers, what limited them, a win, a challenge and notes. Updates today's entry if one exists. Use when the user wants to log, track or record how they are today.

flare_severity.description: Flare severity 1-10, if a flare day

is_flare_day.description: True if today is a flare day

limiting_factors.description: What limited the user today (pain, fatigue, brain fog, sleep...)

overall_feeling.description: Overall, how the user feels today, 1 (worst) to 10 (best)

name: log_daily_check_in
title: Log my daily check-in
